senses.def: A village and civil parish in Mid Devon district, Devon, England (OS grid ref ST0612).
A village and civil parish in South Kesteven district, Lincolnshire, England (OS grid ref TF0607).
An unincorporated community in Monongalia County, West Virginia, United States.
A major museum and art gallery in Florence, Italy.
A prominent art museum (Italianː Galleria degli Uffizi) located adjacent to the Piazza della Signoria in the Historic Centre of Florence, Italy.
A village and civil parish in the City of Peterborough, Cambridgeshire, England (OS grid ref TF0904).
A village and civil parish in East Suffolk district, Suffolk, England, previously in Suffolk Coastal district (OS grid ref TM2952).
Expressing surprise, dismay, relief, exhaustion, or a sudden shock to the senses.
A term for sensory overload. Can be used as an expression of surprise, astonishment and sometimes dismay.

ex: And, as in uffish thought he stood, / The Jabberwock, with eyes of flame, / Came whiffling through the tulgey wood, / And burbled as it came!
